description: Gets one whole page of the Stablevoy documentation as Markdown. Needs no key. Pass a path from search_docs; the OpenAPI outline lists every API endpoint with its parameters, the errors page every error code with what to do. Only Stablevoy pages are read: any other address is refused with the list of pages, and a page over 1 MB is refused rather than cut. Use search_docs first when you do not know which page has the answer.

path.description: A docs path like "/docs/webhooks.md", or "openapi", or "errors".

name: get_doc
title: Read a Stablevoy documentation page
